# Screenshot archive

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-screenshot-index.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

11 product screens and 39 marketing pages (14.3 MB total), all captured from a local run of the real application, not mockups, and not a staging environment with hand-placed data. 46 came out of the automated capture runs; 4 were taken by hand during a QA sweep and are listed separately below.

The product screens are populated by `apps/web/scripts/demo-seed.ts`, a deterministic `@faker-js/faker` seed built through the application's own domain functions rather than direct row inserts.

> **Read this before judging the product by this archive.** This archive is a fraction of what the capture spec asks for. The original run wrote 43 files, but the spec only failed a screen on HTTP >= 400, and the router redirects on the client, so every screen the seeded account could not reach still resolved 200 and was written to disk under the requested screen's name. 38 of the 43 files were the onboarding gate wearing another screen's filename. Those were deleted rather than relabelled, and the spec now compares the landed URL with the requested one. What is left is what was genuinely captured. Re-running the full archive needs Docker, a seeded account that has completed onboarding, and a re-capture.

Seeded workspace: **Riverbend Health Partners**

> 3 locations · 5 members · 18 tasks · 2 comments · 6 checklists · 7 items completed · 6 incidents · 4 policies published · 8 risk items · 8 training completed · 7 controls evidenced

That is what the seed builds. It is **not** a description of what these captures show. The screens that would have shown it are the ones the redirect bug destroyed.

**No real patient data appears anywhere in this archive.** The seed is synthetic by
construction and the repository forbids committing PHI to fixtures.

## Regenerating

```bash
pnpm --filter @phiguard/web exec playwright test portfolio-screenshots --project=chromium
cd apps/marketing && node scripts/capture-portfolio-screenshots.mjs
node scripts/build-screenshot-index.mjs
```

## Marketing site

The site built hundreds of routes out of 11 programmatic content collections (see [METRICS.md](./METRICS.md) for the breakdown). Capturing all of them would be bulk rather than breadth, so this is every hand-authored page plus one representative entry per collection, resolved against the routes the build actually emitted.
